title: Postern Enterprise support-intake ticket
description: Privacy-preserving support-intake record. Minimal data by construction: we sell work and assurance, NOT customer surveillance. No telemetry, no product usage data, no PII beyond a single contact handle the customer volunteers. Fields marked forbidden MUST NOT appear.

ticket_id.description: Operator-assigned id, e.g. PE-2026-0001. Not derived from any customer data.

opened_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp the ticket was opened.

org_ref.description: Opaque contract/organisation reference (e.g. a licence id or short code). NOT a person, NOT an email. Ties the ticket to an SLA tier without identifying individuals.

contact.description: OPTIONAL single reply handle the customer volunteers (email or alias). Store the minimum needed to reply; nothing else. Omit if the customer uses a shared channel.

severity.description: sev1 critical/outage, sev2 major, sev3 minor, sev4 question/info. Drives the SLA response target (see sla-policy.yaml).

tier.description: Support entitlement. community = best-effort only; eval = free 6-month evaluation; business/enterprise = paid SLA.

component.description: OPTIONAL free-text component name the customer chooses (e.g. 'deployment', 'signing', 'node'). Customer-supplied label, not collected telemetry.

summary.description: One-line description the customer writes. No auto-captured logs.

details.description: OPTIONAL customer-authored detail. Customer decides what to include; we collect nothing automatically.

acknowledged_at.description: When first substantive response was sent. Used for SLA response-time tracking.

retention_days.description: How long the operator keeps this record before deletion. Minimise. No indefinite retention.

forbidden_do_not_collect.description: Documentation-only marker of data this scaffold deliberately does NOT collect: telemetry, product usage/analytics, IP addresses, device fingerprints, keystroke/session capture, or any PII beyond the single volunteered contact handle.
